label: PolicyEngine nowcast of 2025 SPM thresholds — NOT a BLS publication
method: 50/50 blend of realized FCSUti-composite CPI aging and CE replication growth ratio, applied to the corrected 2024 base. Committed via the 2020-2024 backtest (see docs/bls-2026-correction.md): mean absolute error 0.76%/yr vs 2.23% for All-Items CPI-U aging after the 2026-07-18 composite repair, which ranks the replication ratio alone first (0.41%); the blend remains the committed primary.
caveats: BLS publishes actual 2025 thresholds ~September 2026; this nowcast is superseded the day they do.
2025 CPI annual averages are 11-month means (October 2025 release canceled during the federal shutdown).

Both price rules ran low in nearly every backtest year (real FCSUti consumption growth and in-kind benefit changes are not fully captured by prices); the replication ratio is near-unbiased (+0.1%/yr signed mean), and the blend's annual signed errors ranged -0.1% to -1.4%.
